2026-08-24 07:53:12.323039 | controller | Also=, or Alias= settings in the [Install] section, and DefaultInstance= for
2026-08-24 07:53:12.323056 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-08-24 07:53:12.323071 | controller |
2026-08-24 07:53:12.323077 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-08-24 07:53:12.323081 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-08-24 07:53:12.323084 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-08-24 07:53:12.323088 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-08-24 07:53:12.323094 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
